name: Jerusalem International YMCA
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Jerusalem YMCA’s stone campanile has paired open belfries, four small corner cupolas and a pierced central dome, between two domed hall wings and an arcaded hotel block. The operator publishes 152 ft (46.33 m); other summaries round to 45, 46 or 50 m. Component heights, tower’s 7.8 m plan and hall-dome sizes are estimates calibrated to current exterior photos. The tower is centred in the mapped hotel strip at local [5.3,-2.35] m; no separate tower part is mapped, so that internal positioning needs independent review. The irregular rear plan is retained from OSM but simplified into lower hall wings and a taller central hotel body. Historic photos and interior photo 2 were rejected as current reference evidence. Fine sculptural friezes, inscriptions and YMCA logos are omitted. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
